---
## stand_report() gives the title and subtitle; a title set here would
## override the one it gives.
format:
  html:
    embed-resources: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 2
    fig-width: 9
    fig-dpi: 110
## Quarto otherwise rewrites any raw HTML table it finds, even one escaped
## inside the viewer's srcdoc, which cuts the viewer off. The report's own
## tables are Markdown.
html-table-processing: none
execute:
  echo: false
  warning: false
  message: false
params:
  contents: "contents.rds"
---

```{r}
#| include: false
## plantpress::stand_report() computes everything this page shows and saves
## it beside this file; the page only lays it out. Reading the figures loads
## the packages they keep (ggplot2, patchwork, plant, plantpress), which
## stand_report() puts on this process's library path.
contents <- readRDS(params$contents)
inputs <- contents$inputs
table <- function(d) knitr::kable(d, row.names = FALSE)
```

## Inputs

```{r}
table(inputs$run)
```

### Species

Each species is labelled by the parameters that set it apart.

```{r}
table(inputs$species)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (!is.null(inputs$parameters)) {
  cat("### Parameters\n\n",
      "The parameters that differ between species or from the model's",
      "defaults. Parameters derived from them by the trade-offs are not",
      "shown.\n\n", sep = " ")
  print(table(inputs$parameters))
}
if (!is.null(inputs$control)) {
  cat("\n\n### Numerical settings\n\n",
      "The settings that differ from plant's defaults.\n\n")
  print(table(inputs$control))
}
if (!is.null(inputs$environment)) {
  cat("\n\n### Environment\n\n")
  print(table(inputs$environment))
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
## One section per figure, each in a chunk of its own height.
for (key in names(contents$figures)) {
  f <- contents$figures[[key]]
  cat(knitr::knit_child(quiet = TRUE, envir = environment(), text = c(
    sprintf("## %s", f$title), "", f$caption, "",
    sprintf("```{r figure-%s, fig.height = %g}", gsub("_", "-", key), f$height),
    sprintf("print(contents$figures[[\"%s\"]]$plot)", key),
    "```")), sep = "\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
if (!is.null(contents$viewer)) {
  cat("## The stand in 3D\n\n",
      "Trees drawn from the run's size distributions. Their positions are",
      "illustrative: plant is spatially implicit.\n\n", sep = " ")
  ## Escaped onto one line, so no line of the viewer's page can close the
  ## raw HTML block.
  srcdoc <- gsub("&", "&amp;", contents$viewer, fixed = TRUE)
  srcdoc <- gsub("\"", "&quot;", srcdoc, fixed = TRUE)
  srcdoc <- gsub("\n", "&#10;", srcdoc, fixed = TRUE)
  cat("```{=html}\n<iframe title=\"The stand in 3D\" style=\"width: 100%;",
      "height: 720px; border: 0;\" srcdoc=\"", srcdoc, "\"></iframe>\n```\n",
      sep = "")
}
```
